services.name: Urban Wildlife
services.desc: Starting on April 23, 2024, Wildlife Removal Companies will require a business license to operate in Vaughan. Check this page for more information as it is available, or contact bylaw@vaughan.ca. During the winter and early spring, wildlife may enter your home or other structures on your property to hibernate and nest. In the summer months, wildlife will seek to find a safe location for their offspring. Residents should contact Vaughan Animal Services if they encounter wildlife that is causing a nuisance on private property.
